111        public static float OFFICER_MAX_PROB = Global.getSettings().getFloat("officerMaxProb");
112
113        public void reportPlayerOpenedMarket(MarketAPI market) {
114                if (recentlyChecked.contains(market.getId())) return;
115                
116                if (market.isPlanetConditionMarketOnly()) return;
117                if (market.getFaction().isNeutralFaction()) return;
118                if (!market.isInEconomy()) return;
119                if (market.hasTag(Tags.MARKET_NO_OFFICER_SPAWN)) return;
120                
121                
122                pruneFromRemovedMarkets();
123                
124                float officerProb = market.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.OFFICER_PROB_MOD).computeEffective(0f);
125                if (officerProb > OFFICER_MAX_PROB) officerProb = OFFICER_MAX_PROB;
126                
127                float additionalProb = market.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.OFFICER_ADDITIONAL_PROB_MULT_MOD).computeEffective(0f);
128                float mercProb = market.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.OFFICER_IS_MERC_PROB_MOD).computeEffective(0f);
129                float adminProb = market.getStats().getDynamic().getMod(Stats.ADMIN_PROB_MOD).computeEffective(0f);
130                //adminProb = 1f;
131                //mercProb = 1f;
132                
133                if (Misc.isExtended()) {
134                        officerProb *= Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_officersAvailableFraction");
135                        adminProb *= Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_adminAvailableFraction");
136                }
137                
138                
139                log.info("Spawning officers/admins at " + market.getId());
140                log.info("    officerProb: " + officerProb);
141                log.info("    additionalProb: " + additionalProb);
142                log.info("    mercProb: " + mercProb);
143                log.info("    adminProb: " + adminProb);
144                log.info("");
145                
146                
147                CampaignClockAPI clock = Global.getSector().getClock();
148                long mult = clock.getCycle() * 12L + clock.getMonth();
149                
150                //Random random = new Random(seed + market.getId().hashCode() * mult);
151                Random random = Misc.getRandom(seed + market.getId().hashCode() * mult, 11);
152                //random = new Random();
153                
154                float dur = getOfficerDuration(random);
155                recentlyChecked.add(market.getId(), dur * 0.5f);
156                
157                if (random.nextFloat() < officerProb) {
158                        boolean merc = random.nextFloat() < mercProb;
159                        AvailableOfficer officer = createOfficer(merc, market, random);
160                        //officer.person.setPortraitSprite(pickPortraitPreferNonDuplicate(officer.person.getFaction(), officer.person.getGender()));
161                        // always independent at this point
162                        officer.person.setPortraitSprite(pickPortraitPreferNonDuplicate(market.getFaction(), officer.person.getGender(), random));
163                        officer.timeRemaining = dur;
164                        addAvailable(officer);
165                        log.info("Added officer at " + officer.marketId + "");
166                        
167                        if (random.nextFloat() < officerProb * additionalProb) {
168                                merc = random.nextFloat() < mercProb;
169                                officer = createOfficer(merc, market, random);
170                                //officer.person.setPortraitSprite(pickPortraitPreferNonDuplicate(officer.person.getFaction(), officer.person.getGender()));
171                                officer.person.setPortraitSprite(pickPortraitPreferNonDuplicate(market.getFaction(), officer.person.getGender(), random));
172                                officer.timeRemaining = dur;
173                                addAvailable(officer);
174                                log.info("Added officer at [" + officer.marketId + "]");
175                        }
176                }
177                
178                if (random.nextFloat() < adminProb) {
179                        AvailableOfficer officer = createAdmin(market, random);
180                        officer.timeRemaining = dur;
181                        //officer.person.setPortraitSprite(pickPortraitPreferNonDuplicate(officer.person.getFaction(), officer.person.getGender()));
182                        officer.person.setPortraitSprite(pickPortraitPreferNonDuplicate(market.getFaction(), officer.person.getGender(), random));
183                        addAvailableAdmin(officer);
184                        log.info("Added admin at [" + officer.marketId + "]");
185                }
186        }
187        
188        protected float getOfficerDuration(Random random) {
189                return 60f + 60f * random.nextFloat();
190        }
191        
192        public void advance(float amount) {
193                float days = Global.getSector().getClock().convertToDays(amount);
194                
195                recentlyChecked.advance(days);
196                
197//              if (!Global.getSector().getListenerManager().hasListener(this)) {
198//                      Global.getSector().getListenerManager().addListener(this);
199//              }
200                
201                removeTracker.advance(days);
202                if (removeTracker.intervalElapsed()) {
203                        pruneFromRemovedMarkets();
204                        
205                        float interval = removeTracker.getIntervalDuration();
206                        
207                        for (AvailableOfficer curr : new ArrayList<AvailableOfficer>(available)) {
208                                curr.timeRemaining -= interval;
209                                if (curr.timeRemaining <= 0) {
210                                        removeAvailable(curr);
211                                        log.info("Removed officer from [" + curr.marketId + "]");
212                                }
213                        }
214                        for (AvailableOfficer curr : new ArrayList<AvailableOfficer>(availableAdmins)) {
215                                curr.timeRemaining -= interval;
216                                if (curr.timeRemaining <= 0) {
217                                        removeAvailable(curr);
218                                        log.info("Removed freelance admin from [" + curr.marketId + "]");
219                                }
220                        }
221                }
222                
223        }
224        
225        public void pruneFromRemovedMarkets() {
226                for (AvailableOfficer curr : new ArrayList<AvailableOfficer>(available)) {
227                        if (Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket(curr.marketId) == null) {
228                                removeAvailable(curr);
229                        }
230                }
231                for (AvailableOfficer curr : new ArrayList<AvailableOfficer>(availableAdmins)) {
232                        if (Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket(curr.marketId) == null) {
233                                removeAvailable(curr);
234                        }
235                }
236        }

242                
243                setEventDataAndAddToMarket(officer);

249                availableAdmins.add(officer);
250                
251                setEventDataAndAddToMarket(officer);

254        protected void setEventDataAndAddToMarket(AvailableOfficer officer) {
255                MarketAPI market = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket(officer.marketId);
256                if (market == null) return;
257                market.getCommDirectory().addPerson(officer.person);
258                market.addPerson(officer.person);
259                
260                officer.person.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$ome_hireable", true);
261                officer.person.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$ome_eventRef", this);
262                officer.person.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$ome_hiringBonus", Misc.getWithDGS(officer.hiringBonus));          
263                officer.person.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$ome_salary", Misc.getWithDGS(officer.salary));            
264        }
265        
266        public void removeAvailable(AvailableOfficer officer) {
267                if (officer == null) return;
268                
269                available.remove(officer);
270                availableAdmins.remove(officer);
271                
272                MarketAPI market = Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarket(officer.marketId);
273                if (market != null) {
274                        market.getCommDirectory().removePerson(officer.person);
275                        market.removePerson(officer.person);
276                }
277                
278                officer.person.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset("$ome_hireable");
279                officer.person.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset("$ome_eventRef");
280                officer.person.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset("$ome_hiringBonus");
281                officer.person.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset("$ome_salary");
282        }

284        public static String pickPortraitPreferNonDuplicate(FactionAPI faction, Gender gender, Random random) {
285                if (faction == null) {
286                        faction = Global.getSector().getFaction(Factions.INDEPENDENT);
287                }
288                WeightedRandomPicker<String> all = faction.getPortraits(gender);
289                WeightedRandomPicker<String> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>();
290                
291                Set<String> exclude = new HashSet<String>();
292                exclude.add(Global.getSector().getPlayerPerson().getPortraitSprite());
293                if (Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet() != null) {
294                        for (OfficerDataAPI od : Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getFleetData().getOfficersCopy()) {
295                                exclude.add(od.getPerson().getPortraitSprite());
296                        }
297                }
298                for (AdminData ad : Global.getSector().getCharacterData().getAdmins()) {
299                        exclude.add(ad.getPerson().getPortraitSprite());
300                }
301                for (String p : all.getItems()) {
302                        if (exclude.contains(p)) continue;
303                        picker.add(p);
304                }
305                if (picker.isEmpty()) {
306                        picker = all;
307                }
308                if (random != null) {
309                        return picker.pick(random);
310                }
311                return picker.pick();
312        }

314        protected AvailableOfficer createAdmin(MarketAPI market, Random random) {
315//              WeightedRandomPicker<MarketAPI> marketPicker = new WeightedRandomPicker<MarketAPI>();
316//              for (MarketAPI market : Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarketsCopy()) {
317//                      marketPicker.add(market, market.getSize());
318//              }
319//              MarketAPI market = marketPicker.pick();
320                if (market == null) return null;
321
322                WeightedRandomPicker<Integer> tierPicker = new WeightedRandomPicker<Integer>();
323                tierPicker.add(0, 60);
324                tierPicker.add(1, 40);
325
326                int tier = tierPicker.pick();
327                
328                PersonAPI person = createAdmin(market.getFaction(), tier, random);
329                person.setFaction(Factions.INDEPENDENT);
330                
331                String hireKey = "adminHireTier" + tier;
332                int hiringBonus = Global.getSettings().getInt(hireKey);
333                
334                int salary = (int) Misc.getAdminSalary(person);
335                
336                AvailableOfficer result = new AvailableOfficer(person, market.getId(), hiringBonus, salary);
337                return result;
338        }

340        public static PersonAPI createAdmin(FactionAPI faction, int tier, Random random) {
341                if (random == null) random = new Random();
342                PersonAPI person = faction.createRandomPerson(random);
343                
344                person.getStats().setSkipRefresh(true);
345                WeightedRandomPicker<String> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>(random);
346                List<String> allSkillIds = Global.getSettings().getSortedSkillIds();
347                for (String skillId : allSkillIds) {
348                        SkillSpecAPI skill = Global.getSettings().getSkillSpec(skillId);
349                        if (skill.hasTag(Skills.TAG_DEPRECATED)) continue;
350                        if (skill.hasTag(Skills.TAG_PLAYER_ONLY)) continue;
351                        if (skill.hasTag(Skills.TAG_AI_CORE_ONLY)) continue;
352                        if (skill.isAdminSkill()) {
353                                picker.add(skillId);
354                        }
355                }
356                
357                for (int i = 0; i < tier && !picker.isEmpty(); i++) {
358                        String pick = picker.pickAndRemove();
359                        person.getStats().setSkillLevel(pick, 3);
360                }
361                
362                person.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$ome_isAdmin", true);
363                person.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set("$ome_adminTier", tier);
364                
365                
366                person.setRankId(Ranks.CITIZEN);
367                person.setPostId(Ranks.POST_FREELANCE_ADMIN);
368                
369                
370                WeightedRandomPicker<String> personalityPicker = faction.getPersonalityPicker().clone();
371
372                String personality = personalityPicker.pick();
373                person.setPersonality(personality);
374                
375                person.getStats().setSkipRefresh(false);
376                person.getStats().refreshCharacterStatsEffects();
377                
378                //person.setPortraitSprite(pickPortrait(person.getFaction(), person.getGender()));
379                
380                return person;
381        }

384        protected AvailableOfficer createOfficer(boolean isMerc, MarketAPI market, Random random) {
385//              WeightedRandomPicker<MarketAPI> marketPicker = new WeightedRandomPicker<MarketAPI>();
386//              for (MarketAPI market : Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarketsCopy()) {
387//                      marketPicker.add(market, market.getSize());
388//              }
389//              MarketAPI market = marketPicker.pick();
390                if (market == null) return null;
391                
392                //FactionAPI faction = Global.getSector().getFaction(Factions.INDEPENDENT);
393
394                if (random == null) random = Misc.random;
395                
396                int level = 1;
397                if ((float) random.nextFloat() > 0.75f) level = 2;
398                
399                float payMult = 1f;
400                
401                PersonAPI person = null;
402                if (isMerc) {
403                        payMult = Global.getSettings().getFloat("officerMercPayMult");
404                        
405                        int minLevel = Global.getSettings().getInt("officerMercMinLevel");
406                        int maxLevel = Global.getSettings().getInt("officerMercMaxLevel");
407                        level = minLevel + random.nextInt(maxLevel + 1 - minLevel);
408                        
409                        int numElite = 1;
410                        if (level == maxLevel) numElite = 2;
411                        person = createMercInternal(market.getFaction(), level, numElite, true, random);
412                        
413                        person.setRankId(Ranks.SPACE_CAPTAIN);
414                        person.setPostId(Ranks.POST_MERCENARY);
415                        Misc.setMercenary(person, true);
416                } else {
417                        person = createOfficerInternal(market.getFaction(), level, true, random);
418                        person.setPostId(Ranks.POST_OFFICER_FOR_HIRE);
419                }
420                
421                person.setFaction(Factions.INDEPENDENT);
422                
423                
424                
425                int salary = (int) Misc.getOfficerSalary(person, false);
426                AvailableOfficer result = new AvailableOfficer(person, market.getId(), 
427                                                        (int) (person.getStats().getLevel() * 2000 * payMult), salary);
428                return result;
429        }

491        public static boolean DEBUG = false;
492        public static PersonAPI createOfficer(FactionAPI faction, int level, 
493                                                                                  SkillPickPreference pref, boolean allowNonDoctrinePersonality, 
494                                                                                  CampaignFleetAPI fleet, boolean allowAnyLevel, 
495                                                                                  boolean withEliteSkills, int eliteSkillsNumOverride, Random random) {
496                if (random == null) random = new Random();
497                
498                //DEBUG = true;
499                
500                PersonAPI person = faction.createRandomPerson(random);
501                person.setFleet(fleet);
502                OfficerLevelupPlugin plugin = (OfficerLevelupPlugin) Global.getSettings().getPlugin("officerLevelUp");
503                
504                if (!allowAnyLevel) {
505                        if (level > plugin.getMaxLevel(person)) level = plugin.getMaxLevel(person);
506                }
507                
508                person.getStats().setSkipRefresh(true);
509                
510                if (DEBUG) System.out.println("Generating officer\n");
511                
512                List<String> fixedSkills = new ArrayList<String>(faction.getDoctrine().getOfficerSkills());
513                Iterator<String> iter = fixedSkills.iterator();
514                while (iter.hasNext()) {
515                        String id = iter.next();
516                        SkillSpecAPI spec = Global.getSettings().getSkillSpec(id);
517                        if (spec != null && spec.hasTag(Skills.TAG_PLAYER_ONLY)) {
518                                iter.remove();
519                        }
520                }
521                
522                if (random.nextFloat() < faction.getDoctrine().getOfficerSkillsShuffleProbability()) {
523                        Collections.shuffle(fixedSkills, random);
524                }
525                
526                int numSpec = 0;
527                for (int i = 0; i < 1; i++) {
528                        List<String> skills = plugin.pickLevelupSkills(person, random);
529                        String skillId = pickSkill(person, skills, pref, numSpec, random);
530                        if (!fixedSkills.isEmpty()) {
531                                skillId = fixedSkills.remove(0);
532                        }
533                        if (skillId != null) {
534                                if (DEBUG) System.out.println("Picking initial skill: " + skillId);
535                                person.getStats().increaseSkill(skillId);
536                                SkillSpecAPI spec = Global.getSettings().getSkillSpec(skillId);
537                                if (spec.hasTag(Skills.TAG_SPEC)) numSpec++;
538                                
539                        }
540                }
541                
542//              level = 20;
543//              pref = SkillPickPreference.NON_CARRIER;
544
545                long xp = plugin.getXPForLevel(level);
546                OfficerDataAPI officerData = Global.getFactory().createOfficerData(person);
547                officerData.addXP(xp, null, false);
548                
549                //DEBUG = true;
550                
551                officerData.makeSkillPicks(random);
552                
553                while (officerData.canLevelUp(allowAnyLevel)) {
554                        String skillId = pickSkill(officerData.getPerson(), officerData.getSkillPicks(), pref, numSpec, random);
555                        if (!fixedSkills.isEmpty()) {
556                                skillId = fixedSkills.remove(0);
557                        }
558                        if (skillId != null) {
559                                if (DEBUG) System.out.println("Leveling up " + skillId);
560                                officerData.levelUp(skillId, random);
561                                SkillSpecAPI spec = Global.getSettings().getSkillSpec(skillId);
562                                if (spec.hasTag(Skills.TAG_SPEC)) numSpec++;
563                                
564                                if (allowAnyLevel && officerData.getSkillPicks().isEmpty()) {
565                                        officerData.makeSkillPicks(random);
566                                }
567                        } else {
568                                break;
569                        }
570                }
571                
572                if (withEliteSkills && eliteSkillsNumOverride != 0) {
573                        int num = eliteSkillsNumOverride;
574                        if (num < 0) {
575                                num = plugin.getMaxEliteSkills(person);
576                                if (num > 1 && faction != null && faction.getId().startsWith("tri")) {
577                                        //System.out.println("32fwefwe");
578                                        num = plugin.getMaxEliteSkills(person);
579                                }
580                        }
581                        addEliteSkills(person, num, random);
582                }
583                
584                if (DEBUG) System.out.println("Done\n");
585                
586                person.setRankId(Ranks.SPACE_LIEUTENANT);
587                person.setPostId(Ranks.POST_OFFICER);
588                
589                
590                WeightedRandomPicker<String> personalityPicker = faction.getPersonalityPicker().clone();
591                if (allowNonDoctrinePersonality) {
592                        personalityPicker.add(Personalities.TIMID, 4f);
593                        personalityPicker.add(Personalities.CAUTIOUS, 4f);
594                        personalityPicker.add(Personalities.STEADY, 4f);
595                        personalityPicker.add(Personalities.AGGRESSIVE, 4f);
596                        personalityPicker.add(Personalities.RECKLESS, 4f);
597                }
598                
599                String personality = personalityPicker.pick();
600                person.setPersonality(personality);
601                
602                
603                person.getStats().setSkipRefresh(false);
604                person.getStats().refreshCharacterStatsEffects();
605                
606                return person;
607        }

609        public static void addEliteSkills(PersonAPI person, int num, Random random) {
610                if (num <= 0) return;
611                
612                WeightedRandomPicker<String> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>(random);
613                for (SkillLevelAPI sl : person.getStats().getSkillsCopy()) {
614                        if (sl.getSkill().hasTag(Skills.TAG_ELITE_PLAYER_ONLY)) continue;
615                        if (sl.getSkill().isAptitudeEffect()) continue;
616                        if (!sl.getSkill().isCombatOfficerSkill()) continue;
617                        picker.add(sl.getSkill().getId(), 1f);
618                }
619                
620                for (int i = 0; i < num && !picker.isEmpty(); i++) {
621                        String id = picker.pickAndRemove();
622                        if (id != null) {
623                                if (DEBUG) System.out.println("Making skill elite: " + id);
624                                person.getStats().increaseSkill(id);
625                        }
626                }
627        }

629        public static String pickSkill(PersonAPI person, List<String> skills, SkillPickPreference pref, int numSpec, Random random) {
630                if (random == null) random = new Random();
631                
632                WeightedRandomPicker<String> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>(random);
633                List<String> generic = new ArrayList<String>();
634                
635                boolean energy = pref.name().contains("YES_ENERGY"); // lol
636                boolean ballistic = pref.name().contains("YES_BALLISTIC");
637                boolean missile = pref.name().contains("YES_MISSILE");
638                boolean defense = pref.name().contains("YES_DEFENSE");
639                
640                
641                for (String id : skills) {
642                        SkillSpecAPI spec = Global.getSettings().getSkillSpec(id);
643//                      boolean carrierSkill = spec.hasTag(Skills.TAG_CARRIER);
644//                      boolean phaseSkill = spec.hasTag(Skills.TAG_PHASE);
645//                      boolean specSkill = spec.hasTag(Skills.TAG_SPEC);
646                        
647                        boolean energySkill = spec.hasTag(Skills.TAG_ENERGY_WEAPONS);
648                        boolean ballisticSkill = spec.hasTag(Skills.TAG_BALLISTIC_WEAPONS);
649                        boolean missileSkill = spec.hasTag(Skills.TAG_MISSILE_WEAPONS);
650                        boolean defenseSkill = spec.hasTag(Skills.TAG_ACTIVE_DEFENSES);
651                        
652                        boolean preferred = true;
653                        
654                        if (pref != SkillPickPreference.ANY) {
655                                if (!energy && energySkill) preferred = false;
656                                if (!ballistic && ballisticSkill) preferred = false;
657                                if (!missile && missileSkill) preferred = false;
658                                if (!defense && defenseSkill) preferred = false;
659                        }
660                        
661//                      preferred |= pref == SkillPickPreference.ANY;
662//                      preferred |= pref == SkillPickPreference.CARRIER && carrierSkill;
663//                      preferred |= pref == SkillPickPreference.PHASE && phaseSkill;
664//                      preferred |= pref == SkillPickPreference.GENERIC && !phaseSkill && !carrierSkill;
665                        
666//                      if (specSkill && !carrierSkill && !phaseSkill && numSpec >= 1) {
667//                              preferred = false;
668//                      }
669                        if (spec.hasTag(Skills.TAG_PLAYER_ONLY)) {
670                                preferred = false;
671                        }
672                        
673                        if (preferred) {
674                                picker.add(id);
675                        } else {
676                                generic.add(id);
677                        }
678                        
679                        //if ((!specSkill || numSpec < 1) && !carrierSkill && !phaseSkill) {
680                        //}
681                }
682                if (picker.isEmpty()) {
683                        picker.addAll(generic);
684                        if (picker.isEmpty()) {
685                                picker.addAll(skills);
686                        }
687                }
688                
689                return picker.pick();
690        }
